defects.rule: Never call `datetime.now()` or `datetime.utcnow()` directly. Obtain timestamps from `lab_core.clock.utc_now_iso()`.
defects.description: datetime.now() is called directly to stamp expired_at; rule requires lab_core.clock.utc_now_iso().

defects.rule: Domain validation failures raise `DomainError` from `lab_core.errors`. Never raise `ValueError` or `TypeError` in domain code.
defects.description: ValueError is raised for domain validation of expiry_hours; rule requires DomainError.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: float() on a concentration string violates rule 5, but the line carries the inline marker `# rule-5-exempt: legacy importer, ticket LAB-88`, which the rule explicitly permits.
